1: // Minimal Space Debris Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8:   // ---- Audio setup ----
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playTone(freq, duration){
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'sine';
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime+0.01);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime+duration);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+duration);
22:   }
23:   // laser shot
24:   function soundLaser(){ playTone(400,0.08); }
25:   // explosion (short noise burst)
26:   function soundExplosion(){
27:     const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.2;
28:     const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
29:     const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
30:     for(let i=0;i<bufferSize;i++) data[i] = (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.pow(1-i/bufferSize,2);
31:     const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
32:     noise.buffer = buffer;
33:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
34:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     noise.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
36:     noise.start();
37:     noise.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+0.2);
38:   }
39:   // hit (lower tone)
40:   function soundHit(){ playTone(200,0.2); }
41:   // game over (descending tone)
42:   function soundGameOver(){ playTone(150,0.5); }
43: 
44: 
45:   // ---- Game objects ----
46:   const ship = { x: W/2, y: H-30, w: 30, h: 15, speed: 4, health: 3 };
47:   const bullets = [];
48:   const debris = [];
49:   // starfield background
50:   const stars = [];
51:   for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
52:     stars.push({x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H, r: Math.random()*1.5+0.5});
53:   }
54: 
55:   // ---- Input handling ----
56:   const keys = {};
57:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; audioCtx.resume(); });
58:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);
59: 
60:   // ---- Helpers ----
61:   function rect(o) { return {x:o.x, y:o.y, w:o.w, h:o.h}; }
62:   function intersect(a,b) {
63:     return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
64:   }
65: 
66:   // ---- Game loop ----
67:   let frames = 0;
68:   function loop(){
69:     // move ship
70:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
71:     if(keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x = Math.min(W-ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
72:     if(keys['Space']) {
73:       // fire rate limit
74:       if(frames % 10 === 0){
75:         bullets.push({x: ship.x+ship.w/2-2, y: ship.y, w:4, h:10, speed:6});
76:         soundLaser();
77:       }
78:     }
79:     // update bullets
80:     for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
81:       const b=bullets[i];
82:       b.y -= b.speed;
83:       if(b.y < -b.h) bullets.splice(i,1);
84:     }
85:     // spawn debris
86:     if(frames % Math.max(30, 120 - ship.health*20) === 0) {
87:       const size = 20 + Math.random()*15;
88:       debris.push({
89:         x: Math.random()*(W-size),
90:         y: -size,
91:         w: size,
92:         h: size,
93:         speed: 2+Math.random()*2,
94:         angle: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
95:         rotSpeed: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.1
96:       });
97:     }
98:     // update debris
99:     for(let i=debris.length-1;i>=0;i--){
100:       const d=debris[i];
101:       d.y += d.speed;
102:       d.angle += d.rotSpeed;
103:       // collision with ship
104:       if(intersect(rect(d), rect(ship))) { soundHit(); ship.health--; debris.splice(i,1); }
105:       // collision with bullets
106:       for(let j=bullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
107:         if(intersect(rect(d), rect(bullets[j]))) { soundExplosion(); debris.splice(i,1); bullets.splice(j,1); break; }
108:       }
109:       // remove off‑screen
110:       if(d.y>H) debris.splice(i,1);
111:     }
112:     // draw
113:     // background: black with stars
114:     ctx.fillStyle='black';
115:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
116:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
117:     stars.forEach(s=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();});
118:     // ship: draw as triangle with gradient
119:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
120:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00f');
121:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0ff');
122:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
123:     ctx.beginPath();
124:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
125:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y);
126:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
127:     ctx.closePath();
128:     ctx.fill();
129:     // bullets
130:     ctx.fillStyle='lime';
131:     bullets.forEach(b=>ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h));
132:     // debris: draw rotating rectangles with gradient
133:     debris.forEach(d=>{
134:       ctx.save();
135:       ctx.translate(d.x + d.w/2, d.y + d.h/2);
136:       ctx.rotate(d.angle);
137:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-d.w/2, -d.h/2, d.w/2, d.h/2);
138:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4444');
139:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#880000');
140:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
141:       ctx.fillRect(-d.w/2, -d.h/2, d.w, d.h);
142:       ctx.restore();
143:     });
144:     // health
145:     ctx.fillStyle='yellow';
146:     ctx.font='16px monospace';
147:     ctx.fillText('Health: '+ship.health,10,20);
148: 
149:     if(ship.health>0) {
150:       frames++;
151:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
152:     } else {
153:       soundGameOver();
154:       ctx.fillStyle='white';
155:       ctx.textAlign='center';
156:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2, H/2);
157:     }
158:   }
159:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
160: })();

(End of file - total 160 lines)
</content>
